title: Does the total fit the common step?
hook: Does the total fit the common step?

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
Integer remainders, gcd, primes, modular exponentiation.
doesNotKnow: Solve ax+by=c by scaling Bezout coefficients only when gcd(a,b) divides c.

misconception: Any integer target can be made by adding signed multiples of two integers.
objective: Solve ax+by=c by scaling Bezout coefficients only when gcd(a,b) divides c.

claims.text: Extended Euclid produces a Bezout certificate for the gcd. Scaling those coefficients solves the requested equation only when the gcd divides its right-hand side; otherwise divisibility certifies impossibility.
